description: §14.8.10 (S456, g-tenant-small-residuals-s455 (b)) — `CREATE POLICY … AS /* x */ RESTRICTIVE` and `AS -- x⏎ RESTRICTIVE` on a tenant-scoped table: a comment between the AS clause's tokens is not part of the statement, so both are `AS RESTRICTIVE` policies and admitted. Before S456 each was charged E-TENANT-SCHEMA-HAZARD twice — 'its AS clause (`x`) could not be read' (the comment text read as the mode) and 'body outside the tenant SQL subset — a comment' (the AS clause read as policy body).
rationale: §14.8.10 statement-kind allow-list (S455 "your rec on the allow-list"): a `<schema>` admits "`CREATE POLICY … AS RESTRICTIVE` (its body read in the tenant SQL subset … and its calls held to the expression allow-list …)". The body a policy is read for is its USING / WITH CHECK expressions, not its AS clause.
